assertions.issues: Step 3 fails: a closed day blocks the guest channel but the staff channel can still create bookings (booking WN8HA3, HTTP 201). Step 5 fails on the warning clause: GET /operator/reservations/book/availability reports pacingWarning=false for a max_parties=1 breach (only maxCovers is evaluated in rsv-day-feed-service.getOperatorAvailability), so the App Book sheet shows the breached slot as normal and only errors on submit; the operator must tick the always-visible override checkbox to proceed. Sites-side and enforcement-side semantics are correct.

frictions.description: Block create can fail with a raw 409 internal error: POST /operator/reservations/setup/blocks for G9-3 on 2026-10-23 (both via the UI Settings form and the API) fails in reflowFutureBookingsForLocation, which tries to insert an rsv_table_occupancies row for booking rsv_1eb4e785 (3Z72EB7Z) on tbl_00d903ae (G9-2) while an active occupancy (booking 6WGYSR) still overlaps there, hitting trigger rsv_occupancy_no_overlap_insert. Reproduced 3x (UI + 2 API). No partial block row is left behind. Blocks on tables whose reflow does not touch that occupancy (T4) succeed.
frictions.resolution: Completed the CROSS-006 journey with a block on T4 instead of G9-3; defect reported here and in the assertion issues.

frictions.description: Deleting a replace special day with custom services fails (HTTP 409, raw 'Failed query: delete from rsv_special_days') when a converted hold still references the custom service: the FK cascade sets rsv_holds.service_id NULL, which trips the rsv_holds_single_conversion trigger. Seen in VAL-ONLINE-008 cleanup and again for the leftover 2020-01-01 row.
frictions.resolution: Worked around by moving the special day to 2020-01-01 and archiving the custom service. Leftover rows: special day sd_00881978-0b09-4d4c-80ad-82e4e74dab1d (inert, 2020-01-01) and archived service srv_e7f28f8c-371f-48c3-93a6-23a3f6933fd8; hold hld_caa3ab1c-47dd-4219-b31a-09fa57ade41a (converted) blocks their deletion and has no public delete surface.

frictions.description: Operator availability and staff booking paths ignore special days: GET /operator/reservations/book/availability returns 141 slots for a closed day (VAL-ONLINE-007) and a staff booking on a closed day succeeds with HTTP 201 (VAL-CROSS-007 step 3). The App Book sheet also offers slots on a closed day (007-app-book-sheet-closed-day-offers-slots.png).

Operator availability pacing warning ignores max_parties rules: with max_parties=1 and one booking in the 19:00 bucket, GET /operator/reservations/book/availability returns available=true, pacingWarning=false for the breached slot (only maxCovers is evaluated), while the booking endpoint correctly returns 409 pacing_parties_exceeded and accepts overbook. The App sheet shows the slot as normal and errors on submit.

Minor script bug in the 008 helper: the slot summarizer read operator slots' 'localMin' instead of 'localStartMin' (KeyError lines in the run log); harmless, operator evidence lives in the JSON files.
frictions.resolution: Noted; no impact on the assertion result.

summary: Tested 6 assertions: VAL-ONLINE-005 pass, VAL-ONLINE-007 fail (operator availability/staff booking ignore special days - a closed day still returns 141 staff slots and accepts a staff booking), VAL-ONLINE-008 pass, VAL-ONLINE-039 pass, VAL-CROSS-006 pass (soft booking auto-moved T4->G4-2 with host notice + auto_reassigned audit event, guest manage view leaked nothing, locked booking not moved and shown in the conflict panel; a separate block-create 409 defect was reproduced on G9-3 and worked around on T4), VAL-CROSS-007 fail (step 3: staff can still book on a closed day; step 5: staff availability shows no pacing warning for a max_parties=1 breach even though Sites correctly omits the bucket and staff booking correctly enforces/overrides pacing). All isolation state restored; both owned dates back to baseline availability (28 slots p2).
